name: signal-processing
description: Signal Processing: digital signal processing for software engineers — sampling, aliasing and quantization, the frequency domain and the FFT (including the windowing and leakage traps), filter design and the FIR/IIR trade-off, convolution and correlation, multirate processing, adaptive filtering and estimation, spectral analysis, audio and speech processing, RF and communications, image and video as 2D signals, the fixed-point and real-time implementation layer, and the classical-versus-learned convergence now reshaping audio DSP.
